title: SIMULATED — Jewar with painted clearing, track and flood
pixel_note: from the run's bbox at 512 px; approximate
zone_note: Example lease boundary: the painted clearing sits outside it.
why: One pair that shows the whole idea. A real satellite image with three changes painted in: a cleared pit outside the mining lease, a fresh track to it, and a flood beside the river. The tool has to tell the human-made from the natural.
look_for: The cleared pit turns red: straight edges and a new track leading to it
It lies outside the lease boundary, so it is flagged and ranked #1
The flood beside the river turns blue: irregular edge, new water
Then open the evidence chain: Verify, then Tamper
story: Real 'before'. The 'after' is the same image with three painted changes: a rectangular cleared patch, a 3 px track joining it to the existing road, and an irregular flood beside the river (painted as dark open water; turbid floodwater in real true-colour imagery may not pass the RGB water test). Not a real event.
